_doc: The 2 million riders scenario: 2M daily transit trips (each trip counted once, all modes) by 2100. The plan plus the expansion package (arterial BRT grid, SH-114 metro, job-campus BRT, infill stations), the frequent-service package (edits.csv), better access (15-min feeder buses, bike/scooter to stations, walkable station areas, drop-off, Wiehle-Reston-style garages at selected suburban stations) and moderate land use (upzoning around stations, 20% of growth steered to station areas). Parking pricing and cash-out are left out: they work in the model but are the heaviest lift politically, and the target is reached without them. Stages are scheduled by riders per dollar (staging.priority), so cheap high-value BRT comes early under the same $2.3B/yr budget. Merged over config.json for this scenario only.
